name: npp_flood_up
desc: Real npp PBA distance-transform kernel kernelFloodUp(short2* input, short2* output, int size, int bandSize) from libnpp sm_90 npp.cubin, lifted to x86 and run on CPU. Phase-1 'flood up': each thread owns one column tx and walks bandSize rows UPWARD from band bottom (ty=(blockIdx.y+1)*bandSize-1), carrying the nearest-by-row site so far: dist=abs(pixel.y + i - ty)=abs(pixel.y - currentRow); update when dist2<dist1. short2 packs a site coord; MARKER=-32768. Per-column independent, pure function of input -> ORDER-INDEPENDENT. Params: input@0x210, output@0x218, size@0x220, bandSize@0x224. 2D launch.
